notes: Mobility now counts control-at-range work, not only stretching. Plank, side plank, bird dog, deadbug, Pallof press, Turkish get-up, thoracic and landmine rotation, cat-cow, 9090 hip and deep squat holds all count. 96 real movements were scoring zero because the app only recognised six words in the exercise name
The Mobility axis is now labelled range and control, because that is what it measures

Crunches and sit-ups still do not count toward Mobility, deliberately. They train a short range under load, which is strength and not range, and counting them would stop the axis measuring range at all. The app now explains that on screen instead of leaving you a bare zero
